name: B10-0418/2025 (S&D) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action after two earthquakes hit eastern Afghanistan in August and September 2025, killing over 2,000 people. It asks the Taliban authorities to stop discriminating against women and girls, which it says blocked rescue and medical help for female victims. It also asks the EU and other donors to send more aid, and asks countries hosting Afghan refugees to stop sending them back.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is a statement of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Afghan women and girls, earthquake survivors, refugees, and aid groups.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the EU Commission, Council, member states, the UN and the Taliban authorities.
